8226.title: Compiler transforms bypass persistence outside production builds
8226.rootCauseOneLine: Serve mode leaves the compiler cache uninitialized, and the test preset constructs an uncached Babel plugin.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — addresses both bypasses; not executed
prReviews.topFinding: An open linked PR already changes the two verified cache bypasses; no duplicate fix was opened.

8226.proposedFix: Share the existing Babel cache wrapper with the test preset and initialize it for serve mode while preserving diagnostic bypasses and invalidation safety.
8226.caveats: Two clean same-agent reproductions confirm missing persistence. Full-shard timings, fixed performance and cross-project reuse were not measured. The complete reproduction is inline; site policy prohibits raw artifacts.
